analysis.purpose: Constructs and registers a UI tree containing a panel, child, grandchild and secondary object, then appends the panel to an owner array. Its precise screen role remains uncertain. No callers or verified game.uso DFS reachability are recovered; this remains a background candidate.
analysis.observed_abi: MIPS o32, 0x60-byte frame. a0 is an owner pointer; a1 is converted from signed integer to float; a2 supplies an index and index-minus-one value. a3 is homed but unused. Slots 6/7/8 are f32 at entry-sp offsets 0x18/0x1C/0x20. Unused slots 3/4/5 are represented as raw u32 words; original types remain unproven. v0 returns the panel pointer. Local homes include r=0x5C, obj=0x54, gc=0x4C, savedbit=0x30, p=0x2C and n=0x28.

evidence: Immutable boundary is 0xD14C..0xD550, size 0x404, with complete prologue and epilogue. Original assembly, expected-object disassembly and supporting m2c output were inspected.
Grouping the flag-save/update/call cluster on one source line corrected the final store order at 0xD3CC/0xD3D0 without changing the operations.

Normal and NON_MATCHING C builds passed with make -j2. Both target bodies equal all 1028 immutable expected bytes. INCLUDE_ASM is absent; function symbol sets and sibling function bytes are unchanged. git diff --check passed.

Existing shared TimB5V3 and the five-argument f32 constructor prototype were moved outside their NON_MATCHING guards. This enabled normal C compilation and prevented unprototyped float-to-double promotion; sibling bodies were unchanged.
Inspected layout family includes D14C, D550, D884, DF14, 8FC8 constructor paths, 03890, D06C/D0DC and game-library initializers 3800C/39990. Shared UI definitions remain in the assigned source.

Shared prefix fields include status/flags at 0x04/0x08, descriptor at 0x0C, list head at 0x10, owner pointer at 0x14 and vtable at 0x28. Owner fields include pointer 0x38, twelve word slots 0x3C..0x68 and count 0x6C.
Panel fields include pointers 0x29C/0x2B8, floats 0x134/0x2A4 and integer 0x2B0. Child links 0x108/0x10C are pointers; grandchild vector fields 0xB4/0xB8/0xBC receive 0.0f/100.0f/0.0f.

The new allocator alias has a pointer-return prototype and resolves to zero. Its identity comes from original func_055750 relocation sites targeting game_libs Text+0x410E4. Existing data aliases remain unchanged and reuse immutable expected symbol values of zero.

Objdiff reports 99.44358% with differing relocation metadata despite exact instruction bytes. No expected objects, metric settings or compiler flags were changed. Experiments remain under build/orchestration-scratch/attempt6.

Fresh upstream port: original compiler in both modes, complete native call/data USO identity checks, exact source-generated tables/constants, exact host function bytes, full ROM and all six strict original code-block payloads.
